title: Add missing region dimension to usage events (Hosted API + OpenAI-compat)
author: Caleb Johnson
release_notes: Usage events now consistently include `region` for Hosted API requests (including OpenAI-compatible endpoints and streaming). This improves pricing/margin attribution and reduces invoice/export discrepancies without changing token counting.
body:
Title: Add missing region dimension to usage events (Hosted API + OpenAI-compat)

Context
We found a non-trivial % of Hosted API usage_events in Snowflake with region = NULL or an incorrect value (notably for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, some streaming paths, and retry/fallback routing). This breaks pricing attribution (region-based price books), distorts gross margin reporting, and creates reconciliation noise between ledger aggregates and customer usage exports.

Root cause
- The API gateway request context has a canonical region (edge_region / compute_region depending on route), but the usage event builder was reading region from an optional field that isn’t populated for all ingress paths.
- OpenAI-compat handler was bypassing the standard request_context plumbing for a subset of endpoints.
- Streaming retries/fallback could emit a usage event from a path where region wasn’t re-attached after request replay.

What this PR changes
1) Canonicalize region selection in the telemetry layer
- Introduces a single helper to compute usage_event.region with priority:
  (a) request_context.compute_region (preferred when available)
  (b) request_context.edge_region
  (c) resolved region from routing decision (when request_context is missing)
- Ensures we never emit NULL for region; if we cannot resolve, we emit "unknown" and increment a counter (see Metrics).

2) Wire region into OpenAI-compatible endpoints
- OpenAI-compat request handlers now pass through the same RequestContext used by Redwood-native endpoints.
- Ensures streaming and non-streaming OpenAI-compat responses share the same telemetry envelope.

3) Make region required in the usage event schema (soft enforcement)
- We do not hard-fail requests if region resolution fails; instead we set region="unknown" and flag it.
- Adds a validation step in the event emitter that logs structured warnings when emitting unknown.

4) Tests
- Unit tests for region resolution priority order.
- Integration test covering OpenAI-compat chat.completions streaming with simulated fallback retry path.
- Regression test for “region missing => unknown + metric increment” behavior.

5) Observability
- New counters:
  - usage_events_region_unknown_total{route, endpoint_family}
  - usage_events_region_mismatch_total{expected_source, actual_source}
- Adds region null-rate to the metering sanity checks query pack (used by Finance/Eng) (note: alert wiring tracked separately).

Data impact / billing safety
- This change does not affect billed token computation or request counting. It only fixes a missing/incorrect dimension.
- Downstream: pricing attribution and margin dashboards become correct for affected traffic.
- We are not retroactively changing invoices via this PR. If Finance wants a backfill for internal analytics / exports, we should do that as a separate, controlled job with a documented freeze window and sign-off.

Rollout plan
- Deploy behind feature flag telemetry.region_dimension_v1 (default ON in staging, 10% prod for 24h, then 100%).
- During rollout, monitor:
  - region_unknown rate (target < 0.01% overall)
  - drift vs ledger by region should decrease (no new drift introduced)
  - OpenAI-compat endpoints: region_null should go to ~0

Testing
- buildkite: unit + integration suite
- staging: manually exercised:
  - /v1/chat/completions (streaming + non-streaming)
  - /v1/completions
  - /v1/embeddings (batch)
  - fallback routing simulation (forced capacity constraint)

Screenshots / evidence
- Before: region null-rate for openai_compat endpoints spiked to 8–12% depending on day.
- After (staging): region null-rate 0%, unknown-rate ~0.003% (expected from synthetic tests missing routing metadata).

Changed areas (high-level)
- services/api-gateway/request_context.ts
- services/openai-compat/handlers/chat_completions.ts
- services/telemetry/usage_event_builder.ts
- services/telemetry/schema/usage_event.avsc
- services/telemetry/tests/region_dimension.test.ts
- services/telemetry/tests/openai_compat_streaming_retry_region.test.ts

Commits (summary)
- telemetry: canonicalize region resolution + add unknown fallback
- openai-compat: plumb request context into usage event builder
- schema/tests: add region field validation + regression coverage
- metrics: add unknown/mismatch counters + log sampling

Review conversation (selected)
Logan Wright (EM Telemetry): Can we guarantee we’re not writing nulls anymore? Also please confirm the routing decision is available on the retry path.
Caleb Johnson (author): Yes, builder now sets "unknown" if it can’t resolve. Retry path now rehydrates RequestContext from the original attempt and falls back to routing decision only if missing.

Nadia Rahman (Staff Telemetry): Please document precedence (compute vs edge) and make sure Dedicated isn’t accidentally using edge_region.
Caleb Johnson: Added precedence comment + unit tests; Dedicated paths use pool_region and do not hit this code path.

Mei Lin (Recon datasets): Any schema compat risk for the Snowflake export? I want to avoid breaking the reconciliation export job.
Caleb Johnson: Kept the field name consistent (region already existed as nullable in the downstream table, but ingestion was not populating it). Schema change is “soft required” at emitter only; export schema remains compatible.

Aisha Bello (SLO/Alerts): Can you add a metric for unknown and an easy panel dimension suggestion?
Caleb Johnson: Added usage_events_region_unknown_total and tagged by endpoint_family; will follow up in the dashboard PR to add the panel.

Follow-ups
- (Separate PR) Optional backfill for analytics/exports with Finance sign-off + freeze window.
- (ENG-4421) Alert on region_unknown rate and drift-by-region after we have a stable baseline.

Merge
- Squash merged to main after approvals and green CI.
commits: telemetry: add canonical region resolver with unknown fallback
openai-compat: plumb RequestContext into telemetry envelope
usage events: set region for streaming retry/fallback emissions
tests: add unit tests for region precedence and streaming regression
metrics: add region_unknown and region_mismatch counters
merge_outcome: Merged (squash) by Logan Wright into main on 2026-02-16. Feature flag enabled in staging; production rollout owned by SRE after merge.
